what: Die-region steering, replicated across four independent generation seeds
answer: Replicates. Every seed's observed own-register lift sits above its own 20,000-derangement floor's 99th percentile, with p between 0.0002 and 0.0037.
why_this_run_was_needed: The derangement floor controls for WHICH REGION IS CALLED WHAT -- every derangement is a relabelling of one generated dataset. It says nothing about whether re-running the sampling with a different seed would move the observed value. That is a separate variance and, unlike the floor, it cannot be had for free: each seed is a full generation pass.
reading: Observed lift is stable at 0.093-0.116 across seeds while each floor sits near -0.010 to -0.013. The label floor and the seed replication together close both sources of variance this design has.
still_not_uniform: Carried by poetry, tinystories, wikipedia_simple and procedural; dialogue, spine and flavour go the wrong way. 7/10 sources prefer their own region.
